notes.title: A-Men 2 available on Steam
notes.content:
Hey there folks! Bloober Team here, we have some great news for you! [b]A-Men 2[/b]  has launched on Steam! [url=store.steampowered.com/app/294190/]You can buy the game here [/url]

[b]A-Men 2[/b] is a puzzle platformer that has been previously released on [b]PlayStation Vita and PlayStation 3[/b]. It's a challenging game where you lead a band of soldiers with their unique skills and try to eliminate the opposing forces. It's no run and gun title, you will need to stretch out your brain muscles and use your surroundings to get the task done.

[b]A-Men 2[/b] features 44 levels set in 4 different worlds, leaving you with a ton of difficult puzzles and a lot of fun gameplay.
